paragraphs.text: The ground floor is begging, and the beggar owns nothing. This world, or friends, or kin: naught of mine. But You are all this again — then who else be mine? Master, Great-Lord, You outright, all the world You alone: may the thing itself ripen. This the begging, and in that begging, begging alone. Even three-worlds-lordship seems straw to Your devotee; what fruit has fair deed, Lord, parted from remembering You? Since naught of worlds nor world-birth is parted from You: Your unfolding, marvel-deeds even, rises with no praise-weaving of You. Thine-made am I, Thy-worship-bound: ever, unceasing, by own sap, dream-goer even — why am I not so?

One floor down: self-confessed lowliness. Brushed by a jot, Your foot-lotus-born fragrance-speck: for them rest-like turns all joy-kind, gods-hunted even. Heart: naught but You. Word and deed: wholly else, Kind One. From the truly Real, grace or curb: one alone be wrought. Dull am I, pain-laden am I, age-fearing am I, power-bare am I. Thine-sheltered am I. Kind One, so ordain: swift I near the highest yoke, sorrow-road-forsaken. Crouched at Your ear-place, my wails, most trifling, take high worth: as reed-joint-fallen water-specks wear pearlhood. What, pray, is unwon, even by such as dote a wink, by cheat even, on Your name? Cool-ray-crested, so act that I, death-wounded, may reach minuteness-and-the-rest as glory.

Then high praise, then rescue. Kind One! ShArva! Moon-crested! Shiva! Three-eyed rosary-wearing! Glorious! Fierce-skull-signed! Grim-trident-flashing! Pity-sea! Worlds-weaving-natured! Fierce-power-formed! Fair-throated! Swift destroy ill-luck’s loads; lay on high Your own ripening. What, Lord, would not be, where the Lord wins not makerhood? What being had the knower, unmade by Kind-Maker? Thus ever sheltered in You, unwaning great power’s High-Lord: here in passing, pang-thickened, I ail, alone. Though pains, age, death here, haughtiest boon-lords, bide a wink; approved, sounds and the rest, unstable ever: yet I hanker, ever-joy-hungering, to stand long for life-drink — joy-taste-yoked Thy foot-lotus-thought, first. O Lord, skilled smasher of the bent one’s pangs, weal-hoard, Matted-haired: of me, pain’s sole seat, birth-death-frighted, now so act that, living even, Thy-worship-bound, I win unshaken ripenings, sweet-sense-taste-yielding, high. Bow to delusion’s great-gloom-smasher of no other work: to all-light outshining light, moon-badged.
